    Discover Life in Wellen Park.

    Thoughtfully crafted for the good life.

    Wellen Park provides a wide array of amenities to enrich and simplify your daily life. Enjoy resort-style pools, golf, tennis, exclusive clubhouses, and restaurants—all in one place where everyday living feels like a getaway.

    ​

    This community offers a variety of home options suited to your budget, lifestyle, and stage of life. From single-family homes for growing families to 55+ senior villas, there’s a neighborhood tailored just for you. And the activities never end. Each neighborhood is designed with a single aim: cultivating the good life.

    Compare Neighborhoods

    Antigua

    Antigua is a charming, gated enclave in Wellen Park that offers affordable new single-story homes by Lennar, complete with scenic views of water and preserves in a secure, convenient setting.

    Boca Royale

    Boca Royale is a gated, 1,000 acre neighborhood in Wellen Park that features an 18-hole golf course and a wealth of upscale amenities including two clubhouses, a resort-style pool, pickleball courts and much more.

    Everly

    Everly is a high-end neighborhood with custom and semi-custom luxury homes by some of the finest builders in Florida. It offers larger lots, a family-friendly setting near trails and its own dedicated amenities like a resort pool, clubhouse and pickleball.

    Grand Palm

    Grand Palm is a large neighborhood of upscale homes by Neal Communities with a large amenities package that features multiple clubhouses, pools, trails, playgrounds and more for family-friendly living.

    Oakbend

    Oakbend is a brand-new gated community that offers customizable new construction homes by ICI Homes and Toll Brothers. Exclusive amenities includes a resort-style pool, fitness center, pickleball courts, a clubhouse, and more.

    Renaissance

    Renaissance is a community of single family homes and villas developed Mattamy Homes. It includes a great amenity package that includes a clubhouse, fitness center, pool, tennis, pickleball, dog park, fire pit, playground, and more for family-friendly living.

    Sunstone

    Sunstone is a gated Wellen Park neighborhood with homes by Mattamy Homes. It includes a clubhouse, resort-style pool, fitness center, dog park pickleball and more. It also has social activities planned year-round for residents.

    Tortuga

    Tortuga is a small community featuring 111 single-family homes ranging from 1,600 to 3,200 square feet. Recently built by Lennar, this established neighborhood appeals to residents who value privacy and enjoy being close to trails and shopping.

    Ashcombe

    Ashcombe is a new D.R. Horton townhome community in the heart of Wellen Park offering low-maintenance, townhome living. This neighborhood is a smart option for buyers looking for newer townhomes while being near Downtown Wellen, Wellen Park High School, and CoolToday baseball park.

    Brightmore

    Brightmore is Wellen Park’s first 55+ gated community by Mattamy Homes. It features single-family homes and villas with resort-style amenities like a pool, fitness center, pickleball and more.

    Gran Paradiso

    Gran Paradiso is a large Wellen Park neighborhood with Tuscan-style homes. It features amenities like a clubhouse, pool, tennis, pickleball, a sauna, yoga studio and more.

    IslandWalk

    IslandWalk is a large gated neighborhood with homes by DiVosta Homes. It features stunning canal views with two amenity centers with pools, sports courts, and more.

    Oasis

    Oasis is a gated Wellen Park neighborhood with homes built by M/I Homes. It offers a pool with clubhouse, a pickleball court and trails with views of preserves and lakes.

    Sarasota National

    Sarasota National is a luxury golf neighborhood by Lennar that features an 18-hole championship golf course and an incredible amount of amenities including a clubhouse with full-service dining, pickleball, tennis, spa services and more.

    Sunstone Lakeside

    Sunstone Lakeside is an amenity-rich gated neighborhood in Wellen Park featuring spacious single-family homes on 50-foot and 60-foot homesites. Many homesites offer lake or preserve views with floor plans ranging from 1,900 to 3,000 square feet.

    Wellen Park Golf & Country Club

    Wellen Park Golf & Country Club features Lennar-built homes set around an 18-hole golf course. Residents enjoy an impressive range of amenities including bundled golf, pickleball, tennis, a resort-style pool, a fitness center, spa services, lifestyle activities, and more.

    Avelina

    Avelina is a gated neighborhood in Wellen Park with 96 single-family homes by Neal Communities. With new builds still available, Avelina offers a maintenance-included lifestyle and is situated near parks and shopping.

    Esplanade at Wellen Park

    Esplanade at Wellen Park is a gated Taylor Morrison community offering twin villas and single-family homes in a resort-style setting. This neighborhood has rich amenities, wellness programming, and concierge services.

    Gran Place

    Gran Place is a cozy, gated Wellen Park neighborhood with single-family homes by Sam Rogers, an exclusive luxury builder. It offers a private setting near downtown amenities.

    Lakespur

    Lakespur is a Wellen Park neighborhood with one-story and two-story homes by Lennar, Mattamy Homes and Pulte Homes. It includes a pool, playground and trails near a future school campus.

    Palmera

    Palmera is a new upscale neighborhood packed with amenities. Being built by multiple builders, Palmera features a clubhouse, pool, pickleball, splash pad, golf simulator and more.

    Solstice

    Solstice is a gated neighborhood from Toll Brothers that offers a serene landscape and great amenities like a clubhouse, fitness center, resort pool, playground, pickleball, tennis, and more.

    The Preserve

    The Preserve offers single-family homes built by Lennar in a secluded setting where residents can enjoy scenic nature views along with light amenities such as pickleball, bocce ball, a resort pool, and an open-air cabana.

    Wysteria

    Wysteria is a gated neighborhood of 153 single-family homes and paired villas crafted by Neal Communities. Residents enjoy a maintenance-included lifestyle with a some amenities such as a pool featuring an open-air cabana and dedicated pickleball courts.
